prompt:
Research the officially documented limits of the Telegram Bot API: messages per second, file upload and download size. Cite Telegram's own documentation or FAQ and quote the limits.

Output format (required):
For every claim you attribute to a source, write one line in exactly this form:
SOURCE: <full URL> | QUOTE: "<a sentence copied word-for-word from that page>" | CLAIM: <what you take it to show>
For anything the task asks about that you could not find a source for, write one line:
NO_SOURCE_FOUND: <what you could not find>
You can write normal explanation before or after these lines.

response.content:
Based on my research of the official Telegram documentation, here are the officially documented limits for the Telegram Bot API:

**Message Rate Limits:**
- In individual chats: Approximately 1 message per second per chat, though short bursts may be allowed
- In groups: Maximum of 20 messages per minute per group
- For bulk broadcasts: Maximum of approximately 30 messages per second unless using paid broadcasts

**File Size Limits:**
- File download: Maximum of 20 MB using the standard API
- File upload: Maximum of 50 MB using the standard API

However, it's important to note that these limits can be significantly increased by running a local Bot API server, which allows for much larger file transfers.

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq/ | QUOTE: "In a single chat, avoid sending more than one message per second." | CLAIM: Maximum of approximately 1 message per second per chat

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq/ | QUOTE: "In a group, bots are not be able to send more than 20 messages per minute." | CLAIM: Maximum of 20 messages per minute per group

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq/ | QUOTE: "For bulk notifications, bots are not able to broadcast more than about 30 messages per second" | CLAIM: Maximum of approximately 30 messages per second for broadcasts

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq/ | QUOTE: "Use the getFile method. Please note that this will only work with files of up to 20 MB in size." | CLAIM: Maximum file download size of 20 MB

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/faq/ | QUOTE: "Bots can currently send files of any type of up to 50 MB in size" | CLAIM: Maximum file upload size of 50 MB

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api/ | QUOTE: "Download files without a size limit." | CLAIM: Local Bot API server removes download size limits

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/api/ | QUOTE: "Upload files up to 2000 MB." | CLAIM: Local Bot API server increases upload limit to 2000 MB

SOURCE: https://core.telegram.org/bots/features | QUOTE: "Official | 20MB | 50MB" | CLAIM: Confirms official download (20MB) and upload (50MB) limits

NO_SOURCE_FOUND: Specific documentation of maximum messages per second across all chats (not just per chat or broadcast)
